from pathlib import Path
import collections
import json
import re

base=Path('.local/tool-tasks/exhaust-reader-worklist-20261007')
inventory_path=Path('.local/tool-tasks/exhaust-reader-closure-20261007/native-slot-inventory-v5.json')
d=json.loads(inventory_path.read_text())
prior=json.loads(Path('docs/performance/exhaust-root-extension-audit-20261007.json').read_text())
source=next(x['text'] for x in prior['oneShotSources'] if x['path'].endswith('TaskExhaustRootAudit.cs'))
section=source.split('TaskReviewedExhaustSourceTypes = new[] {',1)[1].split('}.Select(',1)[0]
owners={'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.'+name for name in re.findall(r'"([A-Za-z.]+)"',section)}
concrete={t['type']:t for t in d['modelTypes']}
parents={t['type']:t['baseType'] for t in d['modelTypes']}
for row in d['allVirtualModelMethods']:
    name=row['owner'];parent=row['baseType']
    assert name not in parents or parents[name]==parent
    parents[name]=parent
singleton_source=(base/'SingletonModel.cs').read_text()
assert 'public abstract class SingletonModel : AbstractModel' in singleton_source
assert 'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.SingletonModel' not in parents
parents['MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.SingletonModel']='MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.AbstractModel'
slots=collections.defaultdict(list)
for slot in d['virtualModelSlots']:slots[slot['Owner']].append(slot)
refs=d['staticReferences']+d['asyncMappings']
adj=collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in refs:adj[r['Caller']].append(r)
seeds={m for owner in owners if owner in concrete for m in concrete[owner]['methods']}
base_names=['EndOfTurnCleanup','CanPlay','Play','PlayInternal','GetResultLocationForCardPlay','RecalculateCardValues']
for r in refs:
    if r['Owner'] in ['MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.CardModel','MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Entities.Players.PlayerCombatState']:
        if any('::'+name+'(' in r['Caller'] for name in base_names):seeds.add(r['Caller'])
# Include the native Hook dispatch definitions. This is deliberately an overapproximation;
# matching selected runtime types does not prove dynamic receiver reachability.
seeds.update(d['nativeHookModelTargets'])
virtual_edges=collections.defaultdict(set)
unknown_hierarchies=[]
unresolved_slots=[]
for owner in sorted(owners):
    cursor=owner;resolved=set();walked=set()
    while cursor in parents:
        assert cursor not in walked
        walked.add(cursor)
        for slot in slots[cursor]:
            root=slot['RootOrUnresolved']
            if slot['Status']!='resolved-local':
                unresolved_slots.append({'receiver':owner,'slot':slot})
            elif root not in resolved:
                virtual_edges[root].add(slot['Method']);resolved.add(root)
        cursor=parents[cursor]
    if cursor not in ['System.Object',None]:unknown_hierarchies.append({'receiver':owner,'unresolvedBase':cursor})
seen=set();via={m:None for m in seeds};queue=collections.deque(sorted(seeds));expanded=[]
while queue:
    m=queue.popleft()
    if m in seen:continue
    seen.add(m)
    for r in adj.get(m,[]):
        target=r['Target']
        if target not in via:
            via[target]={'from':m,'kind':r['Kind'],'offset':r['Offset']};queue.append(target)
    for target in sorted(virtual_edges.get(m,[])):
        if target!=m:
            expanded.append({'Caller':m,'Target':target,'Kind':'selected_model_virtual'})
            if target not in via:
                via[target]={'from':m,'kind':'selected_model_virtual','offset':-1};queue.append(target)
selected=[r for r in d['directCardPileReferences'] if r['Caller'] in seen]
ordered=[r for r in selected if any(s in r['Target'] for s in ['get_ExhaustPile','get_AllCards','get_AllPiles','get_Cards','GetCards'])]
summary={'sourceTypes':len(owners),'seedMethods':len(seeds),'reachedMethods':len(seen),
    'selectedVirtualEdges':len(expanded),'pileReferences':len(selected),'potentialReaderReferences':len(ordered),
    'potentialReaderMethods':len({r['Caller'] for r in ordered}),
    'unknownHierarchies':len(unknown_hierarchies),'unresolvedSelectedSlots':len(unresolved_slots)}
payload={'sourceAssembly':d['assembly'],'mvid':d['mvid'],'dllSha256':d['dllSha256'],
    'sourceTypes':sorted(owners),'seedMethods':sorted(seeds),'reachedMethods':sorted(seen),
    'pileReferences':selected,'potentialOrderedPileReaders':ordered,'selectedVirtualEdges':expanded,
    'paths':via,'unknownHierarchies':unknown_hierarchies,'unresolvedSelectedSlots':unresolved_slots,
    'summary':summary,'isSafetyCertificate':False,'limitations':[
        'declared methods and all native model Hook slots overapproximate search entrypoints',
        'selected source types do not establish dynamic receiver or future writer closure',
        'interface/delegate/patch/reflection/external edges and pile field aliases are unresolved',
        'ldftn means possible subscription, not proof callback executed on current path',
        'getter presence does not prove exhaustion targeting or order dependence',
        'inherited hierarchy alone does not verify complete CLR dispatch']}
(base/'final-reader-worklist.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
(base/'final-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary))
